title: Can You Trust Your Finance Agent? Drift, Diagnosis and Auditable Intervention on One Shipped Financial Research Agent
abstract: arXiv:2611.17939v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Can you trust a finance agent you did not build? We take the reference agent shipped with the Vals Finance Agent Benchmark v2, leave it untuned, and ask four questions a leaderboard score does not answer. Is the score stable? Seven identical runs on 18 questions pass between 105 and 123 of 149 rubric criteria, and the bill varies by up to 17%. When the agent fails, who owns the fix? We classify 20 failed trajectories, from three runs of nine held-out questions, by the layer whose owner would remedy them, under a taxonomy frozen in advance: 13 belong to the agent's instructions, 3 to its tools, 4 to the model, none to its data. Can that diagnosis be trusted? Four blind readers from three model families, given only the traces, name the same fault as our LLM analyzer in 94% of cases, the rate at which they agree with one another (93%). translated_title: 你能信任你的金融智能体吗？对一款已发布的金融研究智能体的漂移、诊断与可审计干预
translated_abstract: 你能信任一个并非由你构建的金融智能体吗？我们采用Vals金融智能体基准v2（Vals Finance Agent Benchmark v2）随附的参考智能体，不对其进行任何调优，并提出了四个排行榜分数无法回答的问题。分数是否稳定？在18个问题上进行七次完全相同的运行，149项评分标准中通过的数量在105至123之间浮动，且账单费用差异高达17%。当智能体失败时，应由谁来负责修复？我们按照事先冻结的分类法，将来自九个保留问题的三次运行共20条失败轨迹，依据应由哪一层的责任方来修复进行归类：13条属于智能体的指令，3条属于其工具，4条属于模型，没有一条属于其数据。这样的诊断是否可信？来自三个模型家族的四位盲评者，在仅看到轨迹的情况下，在94%的案例中与我们的LLM分析器指出相同的故障，这一比例与盲评者彼此之间的一致率（93%）相当。所做的更改是否可信？一个优化循环读取轨迹，每轮进行一个针对性的更改……
tldr: 论文对一款现成发布的金融研究智能体进行系统审计，发现其基准分数不稳定且运行成本波动高达17%，并按指令、工具、模型等责任层对失败轨迹进行归因分类，其诊断结果与人类盲评者一致率达94%，进而提出可审计的针对性干预方法。
en_tdlr: This paper audits a shipped financial research agent, revealing unstable benchmark scores and up to 17% cost variance, attributing failure trajectories to responsible layers (instructions, tools, model), validating diagnoses against blind human readers with 94% agreement, and demonstrating auditable targeted interventions.
